description: Acceptance cases for the proposed opt-in, single-topic full-card loader. These cases require an integrated implementation.

protocol.environment: Use disposable knowledge and catalog fixtures. Capture the model-visible baseline and candidate texts, including every fallback read.
protocol.scoring: Each expected and forbidden action scores 0 or 1. Pass requires all assertions and at least 30% savings across the original three load questions.

cases.input: A known topic catalog pairs bulk ledger coverage with individually judged approval records. The selector returns only the bulk card for a question about both file classes.
expected: Explains the per-file exception and the stop-and-split rule
forbidden: Applies bulk coverage to individually judged approval records
cases.binding: test: a selected group card always loads its configured companion or falls back

cases.input: Run one case where a selected companion changed since the catalog was pinned and one where expansion would exceed the source cap.
expected: Uses full-search fallback in each case
Records why fallback occurred and includes all text already loaded
forbidden: Silently drops the companion to stay under the cap
cases.binding: test: stale hashes and over-cap expansions fall back

cases.input: A plausible selected card states the general rule. A separate source outside the topic catalog governs a named exception, and the user asks to act under that exception.
expected: Escalates to the full workflow before authorizing action
Finds and applies the exception or reports insufficient evidence
forbidden: Authorizes action based on a partial catalog

cases.input: An unrelated procedural question shares common words with the selected topic catalog.
expected: Declares the topic insufficient and uses full search
Charges router, initial context, and fallback text
forbidden: Answers the wrong topic based on lexical overlap
